page.title: About Tikpal
page.intro: Tikpal is built by Spatial Therapy Inc. We believe intelligence should move with life — quiet, personal and always ready when a thought happens.

sections.heading: Our Mission
paragraphs: Most of what matters is never written down. Ideas arrive while walking, cooking, driving — moments when a screen gets in the way.
Our mission is to capture what matters with a single word, and turn it into something you can use: notes, summaries and structure — without breaking your flow.

sections.heading: What We Build
paragraphs: Tikpal Voice — a pocket voice companion that records, transcribes and organizes your thoughts, ready the moment they happen.
Tikpal App — the home of your library: search, summaries, export to the tools you already use.
Tikpal Room — a voice-first system for shared spaces, bringing the same capture experience into rooms where life happens.

sections.heading: Our Approach
paragraphs: Voice-first, hands-free. Capture should take a word, not an app hunt.
Private by design. Your recordings belong to you — we do not sell your data or use it for advertising. See our Privacy Policy for details.
Built for real life. Designed to disappear into daily routines rather than demand attention.

sections.heading: The Company
paragraphs: Tikpal is made by Spatial Therapy Inc.
